artworks.title: La Berceuse
artworks.medium: lithograph with all music sheets
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person bending over a crib or bassinet, with a cat nearby. The person appears to be wearing a long dress, and the background suggests an interior setting. Text at the top and bottom includes the title "BERCEUSE," names like Jean Richepin and Désiré Dihau, and publisher information.

artworks.title: Sleeping Cupid
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a cherub-like figure lying stretched out on their stomach. The figure's head is turned to the side, with curly hair framing their face. Prominent wings extend gracefully from the figure's back. The figure appears nude, with detailed shading emphasizing the body contours. There are no visible objects or jewelry. The background consists of soft, flowing lines suggesting a natural landscape with trees or shrubs and a clear sky, enclosed in an oval frame.

artworks.title: Saint Simon
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 19.7 x 8.9 cm (7 3/4 x 3 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man standing in an arched environment. He is leaning on his left elbow against a surface, with his left hand supporting his head, as he gazes at an open book resting on the surface. He has long wavy hair, a thick curly beard reaching his chest, and wears a draped garment covering one shoulder. The setting is architectural with stone-like textures, a semi-circular archway, a halo-like circle above his head, and a shield design on the pillar beside him.

artworks.title: Young Woman with Her Head Covered
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after François Boucher
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red and black
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (2nd framing line): 33.1 x 25.1 cm (13 1/16 x 9 7/8 in.)
image: 32.2 x 24.4 cm (12 11/16 x 9 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips, in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person's body. The person is in a three-quarter view, with their head slightly tilted downward and eyes looking down. Their facial features are soft and gentle with a serene expression. The person has flowing hair framed around their face, covered by a large, draped cloth that envelops the upper body. They hold a portion of the cloth with one hand. The background is a softly textured, neutral space.

artworks.title: A Waterfall by Moonlight
artworks.medium: brown pen and ink with wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a waterfall cascading down a rocky surface. The horizon is obscured by towering cliffs and the waterfall, emphasizing depth and grandeur. Detailed brushstrokes portray foliage and textured rocks. The color palette consists of earthy browns and sepias, creating a monochromatic look. Boulders and rock formations are in the foreground, with water flowing smoothly around them. In the background, dense vegetation and tree branches are silhouetted against a bright object in the sky.

artworks.title: Moonlight in the Harbor at Dieppe
artworks.medium: color etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Given in memory of Thomas F. Hancock by his family and friends
artworks.description: The image shows a night scene with silhouetted sails on a body of water. The horizon is not distinctly visible due to the darkness but is suggested by the alignment of the boats and their masts. Above, a partially obscured moon provides a faint glow, casting reflections on the water below. The style of the brushstrokes appears to be subtle and blended, creating a smooth yet textured effect. The color palette includes deep, muted tones of blue and grey, with the moon and its reflection offering lighter highlights.

artworks.title: Les Amateurs
artworks.medium: drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of six individuals crowded together, visible from the chest up. The central figure is holding up a book or a tablet, capturing the attention of those around them. The individuals have distinct facial features with varying expressions and wear casual clothing. The background is plain, and the artwork is signed at the bottom, with the signature partially obscured.

artworks.title: Young Woman in Profile
artworks.artist: Marco Alvise Pitteri after Giovanni Battista Piazzetta
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person's body in profile, with their head resting on their hand. The person has delicate facial features, a straight nose, and a relaxed expression. They have dark hair tied back with a cloth or scarf. The person is wearing a light-colored garment with textured fabric and loose, voluminous sleeves. The background is plain with a softly textured surface.

artworks.title: Holy Family with Angels and the Cross, Crushing a Serpent
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: It is a drawing of cherubic figures and a woman interacting with a cross and a serpent. The scene is set around a tree with winged, cherubic figures supporting a large wooden cross entwined by a serpent at its base. A woman in flowing garments extends her hand towards a cherub holding the serpent's tail. In the background, architectural elements are visible, along with landscapes of trees and hills. The composition is detailed, displaying movement and interaction between the figures in a natural setting.

artworks.title: Saint Philip
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with their left arm bent and resting on a ledge above their head, while the right hand is placed on their hip. The person has a prominent nose, long, thick beard, curly hair covered by a piece of cloth wrapped around the head, and is dressed in a long flowing garment. They are barefoot and stand on a surface surrounded by archways and stone ruins. The surrounding architecture is composed of tall stone columns and arches, and the background features foliage growing among the ruins.

artworks.title: Rue de la Bûcherie, du cul de sac Saint-Ambroise (fifth arrondissement)
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image displays a street scene from a city, viewed from a sidewalk. The horizon is obstructed by buildings, creating a narrow alleyway that curves slightly to the right. A horse-drawn cart loaded with sacks is positioned off-center, moving into the street. The buildings lining the street are multiple stories high, featuring windows and worn exteriors. The style shows fine details, crisp contrasts, and well-defined elements, suggesting high-resolution photographic technique. The color palette consists of muted grayscale tones, typical of black-and-white photography, emphasizing the texture of the street and building surfaces.

artworks.title: Fantasy of a Great Hall with Basketweave Columns
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural interior with detailed ceilings and columns. The full description of the image includes a grand hall featuring intricately carved Corinthian columns that are adorned with decorative stonework. The ceiling showcases a series of vaulted sections with painted panels depicting classical scenes. The walls are lined with decorative moldings, niches, and framed artwork. At intervals along the hall, statues are positioned on sturdy pedestals. The drawing captures the grandeur and complexity of the architectural elements, with a focus on symmetry and ornamental detail.

artworks.title: Fantasy of an Ancient Capitol with Trophies and Grand Staircases
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural drawing viewed from a frontal perspective. The scene features a symmetrical staircase leading up to an elaborate structure with columns, sculptures, and intricate details. The horizon is not distinctly marked, but suggested by converging lines of architectural features. On the raised platform are two domed structures on each side supported by columns, with statues. In the distance, more statues and ornamental features are visible on the top balustrades. The drawing uses fine brushstrokes and precise lines to emphasize the classical architectural style. The color palette is soft sepia tones, giving the image a warm and aged appearance.

artworks.title: Kashmir Scene
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image is captured from a slightly elevated point of view, looking over a lakeside landscape. In the distance, the horizon is marked by a range of hills. A body of water stretches across the image, with small boats near the shoreline. Close to us, the land slopes towards the water, where a few people can be seen. The image features trees on the left and in the middle, with a winding path across the grassy area. The color palette is black and white.

artworks.title: Seated Nude Man, Seen from Behind, Pulling a Rope
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red-brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a nude male figure seated with his back towards the viewer. He is in a relaxed, seated position on a textured surface, possibly a blanket or draped cloth. His left arm is bent with the elbow resting on his thigh, and his left hand is holding a tool against his left foot. The man's facial features are mainly in profile, with short, wavy hair and a clear outline of his jaw. The lighting emphasizes the musculature of his back and limbs. There is no visible jewelry or additional objects in his hands, apart from the tool. The background features a cross-hatched shading technique, creating a simple, abstract texture that contrasts with the detailed rendering of the human figure.

artworks.title: Hunting Trophies and Vignettes with Dogs Chasing a Boar and a Stag
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder and Jean-Baptiste Hüet, I
artworks.medium: etching and chalk manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of hunting scenes with wild boars, deer, and game birds. The drawing is etched in a monochrome reddish-brown tone, capturing various hunting moments in different sections of the image. The top features wild boars surrounded by dense foliage and rocky terrain. In the center, there is a detailed illustration of a boar's head with hunting gear like rifles and a hunting horn, with game birds on each side. The bottom shows dogs chasing a stag through a wooded landscape. The drawing's intricate details and dynamic composition depict a hunting narrative with nature as the backdrop.

artworks.title: Four Sheep and a Cow
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper with counterproof
artworks.description: This is a drawing of livestock arranged in a symmetrical composition. The drawing features cows, sheep, and goats depicted in red chalk. There are two large cows standing upright in the upper portion of the drawing, with their heads turned slightly to the side. Below them are multiple sheep, including two standing sheep near the center and two sitting sheep with curly horns at the bottom. There are goats positioned on either side of the cows, each facing outward. The use of line and shading creates a detailed rendering of the animals, emphasizing their fur and musculature. The overall effect is a balanced arrangement of rural life, captured with a classical drawing technique.

artworks.title: Two Pastoral Vignettes, Two Hunting Vignettes, and a Trophy
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder and Jean-Baptiste Hüet, I
artworks.medium: etching and chalk manner printed in red
artworks.description: The image is a detailed illustration featuring five main scenes. Each scene has its own set of objects and characters positioned around a central vertical element. The largest objects include a person sitting with a small animal on the upper left, a second person with a dog on the upper right, and a scene with a fox and rooster in the lower left. In the center, a vertical arrangement of objects such as a hat, flowers, and ribbons acts as a focal point. The color palette is predominantly sepia-toned. The upper left and right scenes depict pastoral settings with people and animals among shrubs and trees, the central section showcases a decorative composition, and the lower scenes continue with animal and outdoor themes surrounded by vegetation.

artworks.title: Singerie with Four Vignettes of Dogs Hunting
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder and Jean-Baptiste Hüet, I
artworks.medium: etching and chalk manner printed in brown-red
artworks.description: The image shows intricate sepia-toned designs on a light beige background. Two cherubic figures are playing music in the center, surrounded by foliage and greenery. The surroundings depict interactions between birds, dogs, and branches. The brushstrokes are delicate and detailed, emphasizing contours and textures. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by earth tones. The artwork has an ornamental quality reminiscent of classical designs.

artworks.title: Five Trophies with Themes of Hunting, Love, and Folly
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder, and Jean-Baptiste Hüet
artworks.medium: etching and chalk manner printed in red
artworks.description: The image depicts a collection of pastoral scenes and objects set within five vignettes. The objects include helmets, swords, foliage, a tree, animals, and musical instruments. The color palette is monochromatic, showcasing shades of sepia or brown ink against a beige background. The upper left vignette shows armor and vegetation, while the upper right depicts a seated animal under a tree. The central vignette features nature, items, and a flying bird. The bottom corners display musical instruments, weapons, and helmets combined with natural elements like branches and leaves.

artworks.title: Two Male Nudes
artworks.artist: Jean-François Janinet after Charles-Nicolas Cochin the Younger
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ellwanger/Mescha Collection, gift in honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: The image shows two male figures seated closely together. The man in the foreground is sitting with his back towards the viewer, facing slightly to the left. He has short, wavy brown hair and a muscular build, with his head turned downward. The man behind him is also muscular, seated slightly elevated and leaning forward with one hand behind him and the other on the man in front. Both men are nude, with a cloth underneath them on the seating block. The background is a soft, monochromatic reddish-brown.

artworks.title: Joan of Arc Standing at the Altar at Reims Cathedral
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite on tracing paper laid down on blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Katherine Baer and Juan Esteban Pereira in memory of J. Carter Brown

artworks.title: Claudius de Saint-Simon, Prince-Evêque de Metz
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting in an ornate chair. He is facing forward with a composed expression, holding a book on his knee with one hand. He wears a detailed robe with a cross necklace around his neck. The background features a grand curtain with tassels and a large clock in the top left corner.

artworks.title: The Piazza San Marco
artworks.medium: watercolor over black chalk on thick wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Joan and David Maxwell
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy square in Venice. The view is from a slightly elevated perspective, showing monumental architecture dominating the scene. On the left is an ornate building with columns and carvings. In the center is a tall structure with red and earthy tones, with decorative reliefs at the base. To the right, there are classical buildings with arches and columns. The color palette includes warm browns and creams for the buildings and a vibrant azure sky. People in period attire, some with dogs, are walking around the square. Pigeons are on the ground. The brushwork is detailed, showing the intricate designs of the architecture and costumes. A red flag flutters on the right side.
